name: De Profundis
source:
After a mysterious explosion at the Grasseille shopping center, Daniel wakes up amid the rubble, in complete darkness. He encounters other survivors and, together, they search for a way out.

But the underground levels they have fallen into are strangely vast, and every kind of danger seems possible.

Especially those you cannot see.
